Advisor approval for schedule changes

Engineering students need written approval from their academic advisor before adding or dropping any course after the first week of classes. The approval form is signed in person during office hours.

A schedule change submitted without the advisor's signature is not processed.

Laboratory safety training

Every engineering student must complete the laboratory safety training before their first lab session. The training certificate is valid for two academic years and must be renewed afterwards.

Capstone project

The capstone project is completed over two consecutive semesters in teams of three or four students. A team may change its faculty supervisor only once, with the approval of the program coordinator.

Internship

Engineering students must complete an internship of at least eight weeks before their final year.
